sources.title: OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-LiteClinicalU-Base-66M-v1
sources.snippet: Model Description OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-LiteClinicalU-Base-66M-v1 is a transformer-based token classification model fine-tuned for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection in Portuguese text. This model identifies and classifies 54 types of sensitive information including names, addresses, social security numbers, medical record numbers, and more.

sources.title: OpenMed-PII: A Small, Open Model for Spotting Personal Data in ...
sources.snippet: Foundation models are too big, generic cloud APIs raise data-privacy concerns, and off-the-shelf PII detectors are usually trained on English. Meet OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-LiteClinicalU-Small-66M-v1-mlx from Modelers.cn — a lightweight transformer designed specifically for token-level PII detection in Portuguese clinical text.

sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-LiteClinical-Small-66M-v1
sources.snippet: This model is a small, specialised NLP model that spots personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, ID numbers, addresses and contact details in Portuguese-language clinical documents. It is designed to support de-identification of medical records, so hospitals and researchers can share data without exposing individual patients.
